business_summary: Shaoxing Xingxin New Material Co.,Ltd engages in the development of electronic and environment-friendly chemicals, pharmaceutical intermediates, high molecule materials, and other materials. The company's products include piperazine anhydrous, 2-methylpiperazine, n-methylpiperazine, n-(2-hydroxyethyl)piperazine, n,n'-di(2-hydroxyethyl)piperazine, n-(2-hydroxypropyl)-1,2-ethylenediamine, n-(2-hydroxyethyl)ethylenediamine, n,n-dimethylpropionamide, 2-methyl-1,4-diazabicyclo(2.2.2)octane, triethylene diamine, pentamethylditethylene triamine, and 2,2'-dimorpholinodiethyl ether. Shaoxing Xingxin New Material Co.,Ltd was founded in 2002 and is based in Hangzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Shaoxing Xingxin New Material Co.,Ltd는 전자 및 환경 친화적인 화학 물질, 의약품 중간체, 고분자 재료 및 기타 재료 개발에 종사하고 있습니다. 회사의 제품에는 무수 피페라진, 2-메틸피페라진, n-메틸피페라진, n-(2-히드록시에틸)피페라진, n,n'-디(2-히드록시에틸)피페라진, n-(2-히드록시프로필)-1,2-에틸렌디아민, n-(2-히드록시에틸)에틸렌디아민, n,n-디메틸프로피온아미드, 2-메틸-1,4-디아자비시클로(2.2.2)옥탄, 트리에틸렌 디아민, 펜타메틸디티에틸렌 트리아민 및 2,2'-디모르폴리노디에틸 에테르. Shaoxing Xingxin New Material Co.,Ltd는 2002년에 설립되었으며 중국 항저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
